items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: The shadcn tokens every Tailwind item is styled with (neutral base, light and dark) and their Tailwind v4 `@theme inline` bindings. The CLI adds only the tokens the host does not define yet. The examples compile the same values (lab/studio/tailwind.mjs).

items.name: utils
items.title: Shared helpers
items.description: The class merge helper `cn` and `copyText` (host callback, Clipboard API, then a selection copy that works over plain HTTP) shared by every Tailwind item, and the app shell's header slot for an embedded page's controls (`ScreenHeaderSlotContext`), installed once in components/utils/.

items.name: button
items.title: Block actions
items.description: Host action metadata composed with the consumer’s shadcn Button, Toggle and DropdownMenu.

items.name: markdown-editor
items.title: Markdown editor
items.description: A host-owned styled wrapper over the concrete borrowed Markdown controller.
items.docs: Create and own a MarkdownController from @hachej/boring-ui-kit/markdown. Pass it to MarkdownEditor. The wrapper does not acquire resources or dispose the controller. Check the repository release notes for available npm versions; local tarball tests do not establish registry availability.

items.name: html-viewer
items.title: HTML source and passive preview
items.description: Exact HTML source editing with a reconstructed passive preview and borrowed controller. Browser security qualification remains separate.

items.name: pi-chat
items.title: Pi chat
items.description: A complete Tailwind chat over the borrowed native chat controller: composer, messages, one collapsible activity block per turn (tool calls and reasoning), message queue, history, a human-in-the-loop question card, an Approve / Deny card for host tools wrapped with requireApproval optional artifact cards that open generated content in the host's panel, and feedback cards for the opt-in feedback tool (lists, and Show offers that the host page resolves). Chat only: no layout. Owned, editable source; no AI SDK. The optional pi-ambient and pi-workspace blocks build on it.

items.name: pi-ambient
items.title: Pi ambient agent
items.description: AmbientChat, a compact floating agent bar that grows into a chat window over an existing page, and AgentNotifications, toasts for finished, failed and waiting tasks (with the one guarded browser Notification helper). A block over the pi-chat item; its in-window artifact panel uses the pi-workspace layout.

items.name: dock
items.title: Docks
items.description: Composable docks: DockLayout, Dock, DockMain and useDock lay out any host content on the left or right of the main area, each resizable, floatable, closable and a full-screen sheet on a phone. Layout only; what a dock shows is the host's. Installed by pi-workspace (which re-exports it) and app-shell.

items.name: pi-workspace
items.title: Pi workspace layout
items.description: ArtifactWorkspace: the chat with a right-hand panel that slides in at full height, a resizable divider, full screen, a full-screen sheet on a phone and an opt-in float-when-narrow (the host swaps in AmbientChat from pi-ambient). Layout only; what is open is the host's. Pair it with the viewers item for the panel contents. Also dock.tsx, which re-exports the docks of the dock item (DockLayout, Dock, DockMain, useDock) for any host content on the left or right of the main area, each resizable, floatable, closable and a full-screen sheet on a phone.

items.name: mockup-viewer
items.title: HTML mock-up viewer
items.description: Sandboxed *.mockup.html artifacts with host theme variables, lazy Tailwind compilation and feedback point comments. Host presentation only; artifact scripts run in an opaque-origin InteractiveFrame, never in the host.

items.name: record-viewer
items.title: Record viewer
items.description: Typed RecordTable and RecordList, with grouping, app-defined status badges and host row actions. createRecordsKind renders *.records.json (records@1), with a phone list and exact raw-text fallback for invalid files. English and French labels and locale formatting.

items.name: diagram-viewer
items.title: Diagram viewer
items.description: DiagramViewer, DiagramView and diagramKind: an agent's *.diagram.json (format v1, versioned: nodes, edges, optional groups, highlighted path and note) as boxes and numbered arrows with a legend that says what happens and who acts. Layers run left to right while they fit and top to bottom on a phone, scrolling inside their own box; no layout library. A superset of a maquette's workflow, which the maquette viewer draws with DiagramView. The pi-app artifact panel shows .diagram.json files with it by default; app artifactKinds win.

items.name: maquette-viewer
items.title: Maquette viewer
items.description: MaquetteViewer and maquetteKind: a PM agent's *.maquette.json mock-up (format v1, versioned) one screen at a time, drawn from the host's shadcn components, under one thin icon bar: Back, previous and next (also arrow keys and swipe), an optional comment icon (point mode of the feedback item: a note pinned on a block names the maquette path, screen id and block id) and a menu with guided tours and How it works (the workflow, inline or a linked *.diagram.json, drawn by the diagram-viewer item in a dialog). Optional phone or desktop frame and #screen=<id> deep links. The pi-app artifact panel shows .maquette.json files with it by default; app artifactKinds win.

items.name: board-viewer
items.title: Board viewer
items.description: A board@1 artifact kind for *.board.json. Lazy native tldraw projection of maquette screens, sandboxed HTML mock-ups, goto arrows and notes. Conditional board-file autosave; phone viewing without accidental frame edits. Hosts supply their resource client, asset URLs and license key.

items.name: shared-chat
items.title: Shared chat
items.description: Optional multi-party host log presentation over PiChat's generic composition seams. No agent runtime or speaking policy.

items.name: pi-app
items.title: Pi agent app
items.description: AgentWorkspace: a whole agent page in one component. Left: the sessions pane (search, New, rename, archive, delete; collapsible, a drawer on a narrow screen). Center: PiChat. Right: the artifact viewers (artifact panel with versions, file viewer, auto-open of new artifacts) in the ArtifactWorkspace panel, a full-screen sheet on a phone. layout="embedded" drops the left column for one compact top bar (title, History, Library, New) that joins an app-shell screen header. Props are data and callbacks; hooks for the conversations handler (useConversations), the chat transport (useRemoteChat) and saved resources (useSaved).

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell: layouts, list/detail and agent layer
items.description: AppShell with three layouts. B "workspace" puts a ListDetail on a screen (phone: the list, then the detail as a stack step with Back; wide: a 20rem list and the detail side by side, sidebar as an icon rail). C "chat" wraps the app's own AgentWorkspace (untouched, passed as the nav item's render; install the pi-app item yourself) in the same sidebar, account menu and header; it takes no shell agent. A "screen": one screen at a time, every screen kept mounted. On a phone bottom tabs (at most four; more give three plus a « Plus » sheet) and an avatar button that opens the account sheet; on a wide screen the shadcn sidebar (icon rail, NavUser). One header per screen through useScreenHeader (title, subtitle, back, up to two actions, the rest behind « … »). The account menu holds « Améliorer l'app » (the improve agent), the app's own entries and sign out. AppSheet is the one bottom sheet (one open at a time, Back closes it). It mounts the AgentLayer: one agent's PiChat above the app (phone: a drawer with peek, half and full snap points; wide: a right panel), the improve agent in the same layer, optional push-to-talk and point mode. Also useAgentContext and readAgentContext (the screen on show travels as `context` with each submit) and useBackLayer, the one Back manager. Built on explicitly pinned Base UI drawer and dropdown-menu recipes, plus the sidebar and avatar of the host's own shadcn style.

items.name: viewers
items.title: Viewers
items.description: The standard viewer top bar (title, status, viewer controls, Refresh, Share, Copy, Download, Open in new tab, Close, overflow menu) with Tailwind panes over it: the Markdown editor with a formatting toolbar and prose styling, the passive HTML preview and source editor, an image viewer with zoom and pan, a PDF viewer, and LocalFileViewer for browser-only files. Owned, editable source over the borrowed controllers; no AI SDK.

.boring-viewer .boring-viewer-checker.background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--muted) 25%, transparent 25%, transparent 75%, var(--muted) 75%), linear-gradient(45deg, var(--muted) 25%, transparent 25%, transparent 75%, var(--muted) 75%)

items.name: provider-setup
items.title: Provider setup
items.description: A shadcn popover for configuring model access: pick any registered Pi provider and model, save an API key (masked, shows "saved"), run a device-code subscription sign-in (code, link and status), set an optional gateway and see when a provider needs one. Transport-agnostic: props in, callbacks out, no fetch. Owned, editable source; fits the pi-chat controls slot.

items.name: feedback
items.title: Feedback
items.description: Feedback from the chat composer: one Feedback button starts feedback mode on the application page (hover, click to pin a numbered note, hold ⌥ to use the app, optional voice), and one chip carries the notes to the next message. FeedbackBar, NoteBubble, FeedbackChip with its review, useComposerFeedback for the pi-chat composer, and PickerOverlay styles. Optional, not mounted by default: PointButton, AnnotateSheet, FeedbackList and FeedbackReport. Picking, masking, anchoring and placement stay in @hachej/boring-feedback/page and /ui, so restyling cannot weaken them.

items.name: feedback-preview
items.title: Feedback preview
items.description: PreviewBanner: a live, reversible preview of a change in the page (Approve / Discard) over `@hachej/boring-feedback/preview`, whose subagent calls models through a host gateway. Separate from `feedback` so annotation-only apps do not install the model SDK; install `feedback` first (its styles cover the banner).

items.name: task-list-viewer
items.title: Consumer task-list viewer
items.description: A consumer-defined task-list schema and controller over the shared text buffer, with a restylable borrowed React renderer.
items.docs: The installed task-list schema/controller are trusted consumer code; publication and draft recovery come from @hachej/boring-ui-kit/text-buffer. Construct a feature with a host-authenticated ResourceClient and exact source, then pass its concrete controller to TaskListViewer. Install native tools separately on the server. No host credentials or native kernel are copied into this item. Local tarball qualification only; no hosted release endpoint is advertised.

items.name: version-history
items.title: Version history rows
items.description: Shared view-only version rows and menu metadata with relative time, provenance and Current. No file reads, publication or restoration.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File tree
items.description: Browse, search, upload and inspect retained versions through one revisionProvider binding. Uses the consumer's shadcn Button and dropdown-menu with shared version-history rows; Base UI style only.

items.name: documents
items.title: Documents: the Library, a file and its revisions
items.description: The workspace's Library as the list, the chosen file in its viewer and its retained revisions beside it (an older one opens read-only). DocumentSheet opens one document over the app for a host's « Voir la fiche », with an optional « Toutes les fiches ». Every read goes through one revisionProvider binding.

items.name: agent-target
items.title: Point and dictate on app data
items.description: Tap explicitly marked JSON app context, dictate once and show the same app agent’s native reply without opening chat. Host-controlled presentation; no feedback report or second controller.

items.name: requests-board
items.title: Requests board
items.description: Host-fed compact requests and responsive list/detail with questions and decisions.

items.name: highlights
items.title: Anchored highlights
items.description: Exact Markdown highlights and comments in a conditional workspace sidecar.
